playback.trackSelection: First enabled usable video track, otherwise first usable video track; playback, Core Image filtering, metadata, and navigation use the same track

playbackIntent.startupGate: Generation- and intent-revision-scoped; transient paused reports are protected until playing settles the gate or the bounded grace period expires
playbackIntent.expiredStartup: A transport still paused at expiry returns the model to Paused unless a playback seek or scrub owns the handoff
playbackIntent.deferredResume: EOF-replay and scrub seek completions resume only when authorized by the current intent revision; a newer Pause cancels and a newer Play reauthorizes the existing handoff without a competing transport start
playbackIntent.transportGuard: Physical AVPlayer playing is permitted only for current Play intent outside scrubbing and with no playback seek handoff pending

frameNavigation.exactSource: Presentation timestamps from the selected video track
frameNavigation.estimatedFallback: Clearly labeled constant-rate estimate while indexing, when exact sample cursors are unavailable, or when the exact-sample limit is exceeded

globalShortcuts.toggleLockAvailability: Always during normal operation while global shortcuts and the lock binding are enabled
globalShortcuts.toggleLockRegistration: Registered in every video and lock state; suspended only during shortcut recording and removed on shutdown
globalShortcuts.lockEntryRequirement: The exact configured global Lock/Unlock chord must be registered before whole-overlay click-through can begin
globalShortcuts.lockEntryFailure: Lock is refused and recovery guidance identifies the configured chord
globalShortcuts.lockRecoveryLoss: Registration loss, conflict, recording suspension, or disabling global shortcuts while locked immediately unlocks the overlay and reports recovery
globalShortcuts.frameStepAvailability: Loaded video with lock mode enabled and exact or estimated sample navigation available
globalShortcuts.frameStepRegistration: Registered only while frame stepping is actionable
globalShortcuts.inactiveFrameStepHandling: Not registered, received, or swallowed through Reframer's global path while another app is active
globalShortcuts.failureRecovery: Shortcut Settings reports conflicts and offers retry

overlay.windowModel: One canonical externally managed window contains the video and control bar
overlay.unlockedExternalManagement: macOS and third-party window managers such as Mosaic move and resize the entire overlay

layout.visibility: Every control remains visible and accessibility-reachable in both layouts

overlay.unlockedAlwaysOnTopPreference: Persisted preference selects floating or normal level only while unlocked
overlay.lockedLevel: NSWindow.Level.statusBar above all ordinary application windows regardless of the unlocked preference
overlay.lockedPointerInput: The entire overlay, including video and controls, ignores pointer events
overlay.unlockRecovery: The exact configured global Lock/Unlock chord restores interaction from another app; Reframer refuses lock without it and automatically unlocks if it becomes unavailable

documentation.renderer: Native AppKit attributed text rendered from bundled Help HTML
